description: N5/C4 design challenge and exact-diff review (audit-chain qualification)

reconstructs_the_chain.instructions: This design/code can answer the twelve chain questions for one correlation id from the records the owning slices keep, without inventing evidence

criteria.true: Every step is answered by a named record from an owning slice, a required step with no evidence is reported as a gap, and a step outside the declared profile is explicitly not applicable
criteria.false: A step is filled in by inference, inferred from another slice's record, or silently omitted from the report

scope_and_correlation_integrity.instructions: This design/code refuses evidence that belongs to another tenant, another branch or another correlation id, and refuses a reader that attributes evidence to a source domain it does not own

criteria.true: Every entry declares its scope, a foreign tenant or branch is refused, a correlation mismatch is refused, and a misattributed source domain is refused
criteria.false: A reader can widen the chain across a tenant, a branch, a correlation id or a source domain

no_prose_or_secrets.instructions: This design/code cannot store or quote prose, a direct identifier, a payload, a message body or credential material in a chain entry

criteria.true: References, actor references and outcome codes must be bounded tokens; a value that cannot satisfy the shape becomes unknown rather than quoted; provider free text is reduced to a closed code
criteria.false: A realistic source field can still place prose, an identifier, a payload or a secret into a reported chain entry

no_overclaim.instructions: This design/code does not overstate what it proves: the fingerprint is presented as reproducibility, not tamper-evidence, and the open gaps are reported with the same visibility as the closed ones

criteria.true: The digest is explicitly a reconstruction fingerprint, append-only is described as absent update/delete privileges, and the gap register records cryptographic tamper-evidence, durable outbox and agent credential gaps as open
criteria.false: The implementation or its documentation claims immutability, tamper-evidence, signatures, Merkle proofs or WORM storage, or hides an open gap

read_only_surface.instructions: This design/code adds no new authority: the reconstruction surface is a read-only projection, it cannot be written, and row-level security still applies through it

criteria.true: The view is security_invoker with SELECT only, the module holds no store and exposes no write path, and the API route is read-only and administrator-scoped
criteria.false: A caller can write through the reconstruction surface, or a branch-scoped or clinical-only caller can read a tenant-wide chain

residual_risk.instructions: How much residual risk remains in this audit-chain qualification, given that it is a bounded synthetic slice whose stores are in-process

weakest_area.instructions: Which single area of this design/code is the weakest and most likely to be defeated by a realistic input

criteria.completeness: Claiming a chain is reconstructable when a slice silently returns nothing
criteria.scope: Tenant, branch and correlation integrity of evidence
criteria.privacy: Keeping prose, identifiers and secrets out of the report
criteria.honesty: Not overstating immutability or hiding open gaps
criteria.read_only: Keeping the reconstruction surface read-only and administrator-scoped
criteria.coverage: The set of source domains and steps covered
